summary: Ported the Key mappings card and the D-pad keycaps to egui in src/ui2/mapping.rs and src/ui2/keycap.rs. Every keycap is an interactive, AccessKit-labelled node (ui.interact via allocate_exact_size + WidgetInfo::labeled); two egui_kittest tests locate a keycap by label, click it, and observe the rebinding state. The modules are not yet registered in src/ui2/mod.rs, so all compile/test/clippy evidence for them comes from an out-of-tree scratch crate that adds the registration, a stand-in theme module and the egui_kittest dev-dependency.

risks: Integration prerequisite (module registration): src/ui2/mod.rs must declare `pub mod keycap; pub mod mapping;` (and `pub mod theme;` for T2). Until then my two files are not part of the crate, cannot be compiled or tested in-tree, and the worktree's cargo test/clippy results do not cover them.

Integration prerequisite (dev-dependency): the two egui_kittest semantic tests in mapping.rs cannot compile until T8 adds `egui_kittest = "0.36.2"` to [dev-dependencies] in Cargo.toml. They are reported as compile-blocked in the worktree, not as passing there; they pass in the scratch crate where the dev-dependency exists. Do not register the modules in test mode before the dependency lands, or `cargo test` will fail to build.

Integration prerequisite (theme surface): T2's src/ui2/theme.rs must export these names as egui::Color32 consts, because mapping.rs/keycap.rs import them: BODY_TEXT, MUTED_TEXT, ICON_MUTED, ICON_SECONDARY, PRIMARY_TEXT, INDIGO_600, INDIGO_700, INDIGO_800, IMMEDIATE_ACCENT, VIOLET_600, MIX_TEXT, SLATE_100, ERROR_BG, ERROR_BORDER, ERROR_TEXT, GREEN_CHECK, RED_600, EMERALD_700, BORDER, INSET. In the Iced theme, BORDER, INSET, ERROR_BG, ERROR_BORDER and SURFACE are private; T2 must publish the four that the card reads (SURFACE is drawn as Color32::WHITE).

Font weight: egui's bundled faces have one weight each and RichText::strong only recolours, so the Iced UI_FONT_BOLD/UI_FONT_BLACK cannot be selected. keycap.rs approximates weight by stamping the galley twice at a sub-pixel offset (keycap::stamp_galley), which mapping.rs also uses. This is a fidelity approximation, not the reference's real bold/black faces; a shared weight strategy (registered font or font face) should be owned by theme/app instead.

Palette duplication risk: values the Iced theme wrote inline are local constants in the T3 files - card border 0xd2dbff, keycap hover fill 0xf8fafc / border 0x818cf8, secondary-button hover fill 0xf5f7ff / border 0xa3b3ff, and the D-pad tile colours (0xf1f5f9 tile, moving-dot rgba literals). T2 should absorb or bless them so the palette keeps one owner.

Not ported (declared): the Iced hover_text reveal-scroll for over-long keycap labels and the reference's pulsing capture banner. The port paints clipped, still labels, matching the Iced port's own rule of no repaint loop outliving the state. Native visual acceptance is still pending, as docs/architecture/verification.md records; the kittest tests cover semantics, not pixels.

Verification method: the scratch crate at C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Temp\kilo\t3scratch mirrors this worktree's src, adds `pub mod keycap; pub mod mapping; pub mod theme;` to mod.rs, appends the egui_kittest dev-dependency, and drops in a stand-in theme.rs with the values copied from src/ui/theme.rs (its sync.ps1 is in that directory). It is outside the repo and is not committed; it exists only so the unmerged modules could actually be compiled and executed.
Compile environment: the scratch build reuses the main repo's target dir via CARGO_TARGET_DIR to avoid a cold wgpu rebuild; no tracked file outside this task was modified.
